sections.heading: What is Philanthropy?
sections.text: Philanthropy means giving money, time, or resources to help others.

sections.heading: Why Giving Matters
sections.text: It supports communities, builds empathy, and creates social impact.

sections.heading: Part of Financial Planning
sections.text: Allocate a small portion of income (2–5%) for giving.

sections.heading: Tax Benefits
sections.text: Donations may reduce taxable income under certain laws.

sections.heading: Common Mistakes
sections.text:
- Not verifying organizations
- Giving beyond capacity
- Emotional decisions
